primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: AESIs were defined as any AE that was of scientific and medical concern specific to study treatment, for which ongoing and rapid communication by the Investigator to the sponsor was appropriate. AESIs included findings potentially indicative of hepatic and renal abnormalities, hypersensitivity, and thrombocytopenia. A summary of all Serious Adverse Events and Other Adverse Events (nonserious) regardless of causality is located in the 'Reported Adverse Events' section.
